artist: The Shady River Bard & Trevor Swistchew
proposal_notes:
Visual Direction for Trevor Swistchew — Option 3: Storm-Lit Highland Romanticism (Living Impasto Oil Painting).
• Aesthetic: Museum-grade 19th-century Scottish Romantic palette-knife oil canvases (inspired by Horatio McCulloch & J.M.W. Turner) where indigo storm skies break open into molten rose-gold dawn over crimson moorland heather and ultramarine Saltire banners.
• Songwriter Attribution: Full songwriting & lyric credit to Trevor Swistchew is baked into both the YouTube Video Description and a dedicated Pinned Comment for the video comment section.
• Pacing & Sync: 41 scenes locked to exact word-level timestamps across the 4:02.08 master recording (123 BPM Celtic-rock acoustic/electric guitars, Highland pipes, and Isla's 2:25–2:40 fiddle solo), watched over by Callum, our stationary black-and-white Border Collie.
